pol-emp-01-c2.text: Arnaud Besson (2018). La Constitutio Antoniniana : l'universalisation de la citoyenneté romaine au 3e siècle. Université de Neuchâtel institutional repository (LIBRA).
pol-emp-01-c2.quote: In 212 AD, the emperor Antoninus Caracalla granted Roman citizenship to all free inhabitants of the Empire.
pol-emp-01-c2.claim: Citizenship spread outward until Caracalla's Constitutio Antoniniana of 212 CE granted Roman citizenship to all free inhabitants of the empire
